steps.saveEval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const L=g.lighting; const r=g.renderer; const S=L.size; const px=new Uint8Array(S*S*4); r.readRenderTargetPixels(L.shadeRT,0,0,S,S,px); const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=540; c.height=540; c.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:0;top:0;z-index:9999;width:540px;height:540px'; const c2=document.createElement('canvas'); c2.width=540; c2.height=540; c2.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:550px;top:0;z-index:9999;width:540px;height:540px'; const ctx=c.getContext('2d'), ctx2=c2.getContext('2d'); const im=ctx.createImageData(540,540), im2=ctx2.createImageData(540,540); for(let y=0;y<540;y++) for(let x=0;x<540;x++){ const sx=Math.floor(x/540*S), sy=S-1-Math.floor(y/540*S); const i=(sy*S+sx)*4; const o=(y*540+x)*4; im.data[o]=px[i]; im.data[o+1]=px[i]; im.data[o+2]=px[i]; im.data[o+3]=255; im2.data[o]=px[i+1]; im2.data[o+1]=px[i+1]; im2.data[o+2]=px[i+1]; im2.data[o+3]=255; } ctx.putImageData(im,0,0); ctx2.putImageData(im2,0,0); const out=document.createElement('canvas'); out.width=1080; out.height=540; const o2=out.getContext('2d'); o2.drawImage(c,0,0); o2.drawImage(c2,540,0); return out.toDataURL('image/png')})()
